label: RSO-EXEC-BINDING-001
title: First-class execution binding for the RSO evidence plane (successor to C-004)
objective: Remove the structural evidence-plane defects C-004 demonstrated (run attribution, world/observer substitution, run status, launch identity) by a thin execution binding, sufficiently to support one native retained-information witness. Closure: rso/binding/CONTRACT.md s3 CC1-CC4.

Q1.description: low-ambiguity / mechanical: CI wiring, manifests, schemas following a settled design, repetitive fixtures, generated docs, deterministic wrappers, simple adapters, mechanical refactors under strong tests

Q2.description: substantial engineering: subsystem design inside a frozen contract, complex TDD, state machines, evidence graphs, runtime adapters, reset/restart machinery, integration, complex debugging

Q3.description: scarce deep reasoning / adversarial: adversarial test design, epistemic ambiguity, counterfeit construction, cross-physics abstraction attacks, difficult first-sight review, failures that survived strong Q2 attempts
